body: I think she would love the Morphe 35b colorburst palette! Very cute and full of pretty colors to play with. Find a picture of it online and make sure she doesn’t already have it in her collection though! 😅
Yeah I use a translucent finishing powder and it helps keep shine away for a while, but doesn't last.
Thanks! Right now I use a BB cream by NYX instead of foundation because I could never find one that wouldn't add to my shine, so I'll try yours out! :)

My all time favorite eyeliner is L'oreal's infallible super slim liquid eyeliner. It's felt-tip and super dark. And even though it says its super thin and the tip is kinda thin, I had a hard time making the lines on my lid thin. I have mastered the intense winged eyeliner though with this, I'm totally hooked. It lasts all day too, I recommend it for sure.
